description: Test Git-over-SSH authentication to a hosting provider (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, etc). Verifies your SSH key is registered and working. Use this when git clone/pull/push fails with SSH errors.

host.description: Git hosting hostname (default: "github.com"). Omit for the default; an empty string is rejected.

user.description: SSH user for the git host (default: "git"). Omit for the default; an empty string is rejected.

name: ssh_git_check
